Maya: Need trimmed battlecard for SDRs + 2-slide webinar narrative + benchmark blurb by Friday EOD.
Jason: Position vs cloud vendors = cost predictability + graceful degradation (not just raw perf).
Li: Tech callout vs LLM APIs: routing + quantization reduce tail latency. Phrase: 'stable P99s under burst'.
Sophie: SDR copy: avoid hard numbers, use 'industry-grade latency SLAs' + link to appendix.
Carl: For infra vendors highlight ops savings: we handle kernel selection, autoscaling, caching.
Maya: Three pillars: Economics, Reliability, Dev velocity. Each 1-liner + proof point.
Jason: Economics: 'Turn variable token bills into predictable engineering capacity.'
Li: Reliability: 'Automatic fallbacks and region-aware routing keep flows alive.'
Sophie: Dev velocity: 'Single API across hosted/dedicated/private.'
Maya: Webinar slides: slide1 problem + customer cost vignette; slide2 solution + 5-min demo of canary rollback.
Carl: I will record demo Wed. Need infra slot.
Jason: SDR one-pager bullets: what, why, proof points, CTA to benchmark + webinar.
Sophie: Add two objection handlers: why not vendor X -> SLOs/fallbacks; on-prem -> Private deployment option.
Li: I'll produce a small reproducibility snippet for the appendix.
Maya: ops-bot, set reminder for deck review Thu 10:00.
ops-bot: Reminder set in #marketing: 'Battlecard + webinar deck review' Thu 10:00.
